1.consolidated_definition: Atender con esmero la apariencia física de una persona, mascota, vehículo, etc. Nota: Para persona, también se usa como pronominal (acicalarse). Barbero boricua es el encargado de acicalar a los jugadores de la NBA.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To attend to the physical appearance of a person, pet, vehicle, etc., with meticulous care. Note: For a person, it is also used as a reflexive verb (to primp oneself). A barber from Puerto Rico is responsible for grooming NBA players.
